examples.text: yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ assādeti nikāmeti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu giddho papatāya anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkh'ūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.

24908.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of giddhilobhapaccaya
24908.meaning1: dependent on greed and covetousness; due to intense desire
24908.construction:
giddhi + lobha + paccaya + ā
giddhilobhapaccaya + ā

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana giddhilobhī assaṃ, attā'pi maṃ upavadeyya giddhilobhapaccayā, anuviccā'pi maṃ viññū garaheyyuṃ giddhilobhapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā giddhilobhapaccayā.

24910.commentary: (SNa) vacchagiddhiniyo'ti vacchesu sasnehā thanehi khīraṃ paggharantehi vacchakasnehena sayam'eva gamissantī'ti.

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, nanda, sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātehī'ti. gamissanti, bhante, gāvo vacchagiddhiniyo'ti. niyyāteh'eva tvaṃ, nanda, sāmikānaṃ gāvo'ti.
akkodhano vigatakhilo'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiy'ekarattivāso, vivaṭā kuṭi nibbuto gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

divā abbhokāse viharāmi rattiṃ vanasaṇḍe'ti gimhakāle kir'esa divā abbhokāse vihāsi, ten'assa kacchehi sedadhārā mucciṃsu, rattiṃ assāso bhaveyya, ayaṃ pana sūriye atthaṃ gacchante'y'eva vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati.

24914.commentary: (VINa) māso seso gimhānan'ti catunnaṃ gimhamāsānaṃ eko pacchimamāso seso.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ūhataṃ rajojallaṃ, tam'enaṃ mahā-akālamegho ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
māso seso gimhānan'ti, bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.

24915.commentary: (SNPa) gimhāna māse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe'ti ye cattāro gimhamāsā, tesaṃ catunnaṃ gimhānaṃ ekasmiṃ māse.
24915.notes: wrong derivation of gen pl of gimhā. gimhānaṃ > gimhāna

examples.text: addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti katvā nivāsetabbanti. addhamāse sese gimhāne katvā nivāsetabbaṃ
vanappagumbe yathā phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe. tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya.
vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

24917.meaning1: in the last month of the hot season

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭena'pi vidhūpanena'pi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossavane'pi tiṇāni na icchanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ṭhite majjh'anhike kāle marīcikā phandati.

24918.commentary: (DHPa) hemantagimhisū'ti hemantagimhesu'pi cattāro māse idañ'c'idañ'ca karonto idh'eva vasissāmī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaṃ atthaṃ ajānanto bālo vicinteti.

examples.text: idha vassaṃ vasissāmi, idha hem'antagimhisu, iti bālo vicinteti, antarāyaṃ na bujjhati.

24919.meaning1: hot; for the summer; related to the summer season

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi, ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hem'antikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ, pañca kāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpesi
tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ yaso nāma kulaputto seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti. tassa tayo pāsādā honti, eko hem'antiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.
ayaṃ gimho'tu, asmiñ'ca utumhi aṭṭha uposathā, iminā pakkhena, eko uposatho sampatto, eko uposathā atikkantā, cha uposathā avasiṭṭhā.

24922.commentary: (VINa) gir'aggasamajjo'ti girimhi aggasamajjo, girissa vā aggadese samajjo. (PYt) imehi padehi aggo samajjo aggasamajjo, girimhi pavatto aggasamajjo gir'aggasamajjo'ti atthaṃ dasseti. samajjo'ti ca sabhā. sā hi samāgamaṃ ajanti gacchanti janā etthā'ti samajjo'ti vuccati. girissa vā'ti-ādinā girissa aggo koṭi gir'aggo, tasmiṃ pavatto samajjo gir'aggasamajjo'ti attho dassito.

examples.text: akakkasaṃ viññāpaniṃ, giraṃ saccam'udīraye, yāya n'ābhisaje kañci, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sampajānamusāvādo nāma visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā, girā, byappatho, vacībhedo, vācasikā viññatti, aṭṭha anariyavohārā, adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me'ti, assutaṃ sutaṃ me'ti

24924.commentary: (MNa) girī'ti pabbato (THa) girinā'ti selena. selo hi sandhisaṅkhātehi pabbehi ṭhitattā pabbato'ti, pasavan'ādi-vasena jalassa, sārabhūtānaṃ bhesajj'ādivatthūnañ'ca giraṇato girī'ti vuccati. tadubhay'atthasambhavato pan'ettha pabbatenā'ti vatvā girinā'ti ca vuttaṃ.

examples.text: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
anuddhato acapalo, nipako saṃvut'indriyo, sobhati paṃsukūlena, sīho'va girigabbhare.

24926.meaning2: plant Clitoria ternatea, blue morning glory

examples.text: kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane, dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ, paccuṭṭhahitvā amatassa pattiyā, saṃcintaye taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
anuddhato acapalo, nipako saṃvut'indriyo, sobhati paṃsukūlena, sīho'va girigabbhare.

24928.meaning1: name of a village in Sri Lanka

examples.text: daharo kira ākāsena gacchanto girigāmavāsikammāradhītāya pañcahi kumārīhi saddhiṃ padumasaraṃ gantvā nhatvā padumāni ca pilandhitvā madhurassarena gāyantiyā saddaṃ sutvā kāmarāgena viddho visesā parihāyitvā anayabyasanaṃ pāpuṇi.

24929.commentary: (MNa) giriguhan'ti dvinnaṃ pabbatānaṃ antarā, ekasmiṃ'y'eva vā umaṅgasadisaṃ mahāvivaraṃ.

examples.text: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
giriduggacaraṃ chetaṃ, appapaññaṃ acetasaṃ, akāle ovadaṃ bhikkhu, mando'va paṭibhāti maṃ.
kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vāt'ātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā, na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atth'atthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

24933.meaning1: name of a former capital of Magadha
24933.meaning2: name of a former capital of Magadha
24933.commentary: (SNPa) giribbajan'ti idam'pi tassa nāmaṃ. tañ'hi paṇḍava-gijjhakūṭa-vebhāra-isigili-vepulla-nāmakānaṃ pañcannaṃ girīnaṃ majjhe vajo viya ṭhitaṃ, tasmā giribbajan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: agamā rājagahaṃ buddho, magadhānaṃ giribbajaṃ, piṇḍāya abhihāresi, ākiṇṇavaralakkhaṇo.

24934.meaning1: name of a monastery in Sri Lanka

24935.meaning1: great devotional offering at Giribhaṇḍa monastery

24936.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde rājagahe bimbisārarañño purohitassa putto hutvā nibbatti, girimānando'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi.
24936.notes: Theragāthā verses 325-329 (TH5.3, TH200) are attributed to him.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā girimānando ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.

24940.meaning1: summit of a hill; peak of a mountain
24940.commentary: (THIa) takkāriṃ pupphitaṃ girimuddhanī'ti pabbatamuddhani ṭhitaṃ supupphitadālimalaṭṭhiṃ viya.

examples.text: kāḷ'aṅginiṃ'va takkāriṃ, pupphitaṃ girimuddhani, phullaṃ dālimalaṭṭhiṃ'va, antodīpe'va pāṭaliṃ.

24941.commentary: (APAa) atha māro devaputto diyaḍḍhayojanasatikaṃ girimekhalaṃ nāma hatthiṃ abhiruhitvā bāhusahassaṃ māpetvā nānāvudhāni aggahesi.

examples.text: vipulo rājagahīyānaṃ, giriseṭṭho pavuccati, seto himavataṃ seṭṭho, ādicco aghagāminaṃ.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.
app'eva nām'etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan'assā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya. tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya.
addasā kho dutiyo akkhadhutto taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ dutiyam'pi āgat'āgataṃ kaliṃ gilantaṃ, disvā taṃ akkhadhuttaṃ etadavoca.

24949.meaning1: who has swallowed the hook; who has taken the bait
24949.meaning2: swallowing the hook; who has swallowed the hook

examples.text: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhun'upassayaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānā hoti bhikkhunī, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
tayo'me, bhikkhave, gilānā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo?
āgantukassa dānaṃ deti, gamikassa dānaṃ deti, gilānassa dānaṃ deti, dubbhikkhe dānaṃ deti, yāni tāni navasassāni navaphalāni tāni paṭhamaṃ sīlavantesu patiṭṭhāpeti.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāv'ābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.

24953.meaning1: who is sick; unwell person; ill person

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano, dāsā'ti vā pessā'ti vā kammakarā'ti vā, tesaṃ katañ'ca katato jānāti akatañ'ca akatato jānāti, gilānakānañ'ca bal'ābalaṃ jānāti khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyañ'c'assa paccaṃsena saṃvibhajati.
addasā kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ, disvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.

24955.meaning1: sick person, nursing assistant, new arrival and the traveller
24955.compound: dvanda (gilāna ca gilānupaṭṭhāka ca āgantuka ca gamika ca)

24956.meaning2: (what is) is leftover from a sick person's meal

examples.text: saṃyojanaṃ dve isidattā, mahako kāmabhūpi ca, godatto ca nigaṇṭho ca, acelena gilānadassanan'ti.

24959.commentary: (VINa) gilānapaccayo'va bhesajjaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaṃ, yaṃkiñci gilānassa sappāyaṃ bhisakkakammaṃ telamadhuphāṇit'ādī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: adhivāsetu no bhante, gilānapaccayaṃ imaṃ, anukampaṃ upādāya, paṭigaṇhātu'm'uttama.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārehi. tatra bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya.

24960.meaning1: healthcare and medicine; support for the sick and medicine

examples.text: bhisakkassa kammaṃ tena anuññātattā'ti bhesajjaṃ. gilānapaccayo'va bhesajjaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaṃ, yaṃkiñci gilānassa sappāyaṃ bhisakkakammaṃ tela-madhu-phāṇit'ādī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. parikkhāro'ti pana sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hotī'ti-ādīsu (a. ni. 7.67) parivāro vuccati.

24961.meaning1: healthcare and medicinal ingredients; support for the sick and medical requisites
24961.commentary: (VISM) gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāran'ti ettha rogassa paṭiayan'aṭṭhena paccayo, paccanīkagaman'aṭṭhenā'ti attho. yassa kassaci sappāyass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. bhisakkassa kammaṃ tena anuññātattā'ti bhesajjaṃ. gilānapaccayo'va bhesajjaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaṃ, yaṃkiñci gilānassa sappāyaṃ bhisakkakammaṃ telamadhuphāṇit'ādī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāraṃ paṭisevāmi yāva'd'eva uppannānaṃ veyyābādhikānaṃ vedanānaṃ paṭighātāya abyāpajjha-paramatāyā

24962.commentary: (ANa) cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhār'ānuppadān'atthaṃ padhānan'ti etesaṃ cīvar'ādīnaṃ catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ anuppadān'atthāya padhānaṃ nāma durabhisambhavan'ti dasseti. caturatanikam'pi hi pilotikaṃ, pasatataṇḍulamattaṃ vā bhattaṃ, caturatanikaṃ vā paṇṇasālaṃ, telasappinavanīt'ādīsu vā appamattakam'pi bhesajjaṃ paresaṃ dethā'ti vattum'pi nīharitvā dātum'pi dukkaraṃ ubhatobyūḷhasaṅgāmappavesanasadisaṃ.

examples.text: imesaṃ pana, bhikkhave, tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikamma-cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhār'ānuppadānenā'ti.

24963.meaning1: who asks after a sick person; who enquires about (the health of) a patient

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen'āyasmā mahācundo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahācundaṃ etadavoca, āyām'āvuso cunda, yen'āyasmā channo ten'upasaṅkamissāma gilānapucchakā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti. gilānapucchakā bhikkhū gilāne bhikkhū etadavocuṃ, kacc'āvuso, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyan'ti?

24964.commentary: (MNa) gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānan'ti sappitelamadhuphāṇitādīnaṃ uttamabhesajjānaṃ. sabbatthā'pi ṭhānaṃ bahussutehi puññavantehi ca yojetabbaṃ.

examples.text: yesañ'ca mayaṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāma, tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā

24965.meaning1: invitation for medical requisites; offer of medical support

examples.text: agilānena bhikkhunā catumāsappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā'ti gilānappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā.

24966.meaning1: healthcare and medicinal ingredients; support for the sick and medical requisites

examples.text: yesañ'ca mayaṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāma, tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā
āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārahetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

24967.meaning1: for the sake of healthcare and medicinal ingredients; for the sake of support for the sick and medical requisites

examples.text: āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.
na kho pan'āhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito na piṇḍapātahetu… na sen'āsanahetu… na gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.

24969.commentary: (VINa) gilānabhattampi sace sabbesaṃ gilānānaṃ pahoti, sabbesaṃ dātabbaṃ, no ce, ṭhitikaṃ katvā gāhetabbaṃ.

examples.text: imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.

tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti, gilānabhattaṃ detha, gilān'upaṭṭhākabhattaṃ detha, gilānabhesajjaṃ dethā'ti. jīvako'pi komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi.

24970.synonym: ātaṅka, ābādha, gada, gilāna, byādhi, roga

examples.text: imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.

tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti, gilānabhattaṃ detha, gilān'upaṭṭhākabhattaṃ detha, gilānabhesajjaṃ dethā'ti. jīvako'pi komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi.

24973.commentary: (KVt) gilānassa gilānasaññino'ti gilānassa pana gilāno ahan'ti saññino anuvasitvā bhuñjantassa anāpatti.

examples.text: agilāno vematiko tat'uttari āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. agilāno gilānasaññī tat'uttariṃ āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

24974.meaning1: time of sickness; occasion of illness
24974.commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.2) gilānasamayo nāma antamaso pādā'pi phalitā honti. gilānasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ. (VIN 2.5.6.7) gilānasamayo nāma yassa vinā nahānena na phāsu hoti, gilānasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāv'ābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
param'parabhojane aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
atha kho bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.

24981.meaning2: Chapter 8 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

24982.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā navavādañ'ca sutvā gilānavādañ'ca, appaññāto bhikkhū'ti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami.

24985.meaning1: recovered from the illness; got better

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato so ābādho paṭipassambhi. atha kho bhagavā gilānavuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamma vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa so ābādho paṭippassambhī'ti. atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ gilānavuṭṭhitaṃ aciravuṭṭhitaṃ gelaññā etadavoca

24986.commentary: (VINa) gilān'ātirittan'ti ettha na kevalaṃ yaṃ gilānassa bhutt'āvasesaṃ hoti, taṃ gilān'ātirittaṃ, atha kho yaṃkiñci gilānaṃ uddissa ajja vā sve vā yadā vā icchati, tadā khādissatī'ti āhaṭaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ gilān'ātirittan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā vuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti, alam'etaṃ sabban'ti avuttaṃ hoti, na gilān'ātirittaṃ hoti, etaṃ anatirittaṃ nāma.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gilānāvuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. tassa evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ kho gilānāvuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño, hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti.
atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa so ābādho paṭippassambhī'ti. atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ gilānāvuṭṭhitaṃ aciravuṭṭhitaṃ gelaññā etadavoca
imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.

24990.meaning1: attending to the sick; nursing those ill
24990.meaning2: who attends the sick; who cares for a sick person

examples.text: atha kho tassa gilān'upaṭṭhākassa bhikkhuno etadahosi, bhagavatā paññattaṃ na anissitena vatthabban'ti. ahañ'c'amhi nissayakaraṇīyo, ayañ'ca bhikkhu gilāno, kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban'ti?
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhākīnaṃ yadidaṃ suppiyā upāsikā.

24993.meaning1: caring for the sick; looking after the unwell
24993.meaning2: tending or nursing of the sick
24993.commentary: (DNa) gilānupaṭṭhānenā'ti aphāsukakāle kammaṃ akāretvā sappāyabhesajj'ādīni datvā paṭijagganena.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānena bhattavetan'ānuppadānena gilān'upaṭṭhānena acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena samaye vossaggena.

24994.meaning1: like a sick person; similar to a patient

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tayo'me gilān'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo?
jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
yo andhakāre tamasi pabhaṅ'karo, verocano maṇḍalī uggatejo. mā rāhu gilī caram'antalikkhe, pajaṃ mamaṃ rāhu pamuñca sūriyan'ti.

24996.commentary: (NPa) ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassā'ti ayaṃ, bhikkhu, kilesamārassa baḷisabhūtaṃ rūpataṇhaṃ gilitvā ṭhito'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.

24997.meaning1: swallowed the hook; taken the bait (of)
24997.commentary: (NPa) ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassā'ti ayaṃ, bhikkhu, kilesamārassa baḷisabhūtaṃ rūpataṇhaṃ gilitvā ṭhito'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.

24998.commentary: (THIa) mā puthulomo'va baḷisaṃ gilitvā'ti āmisalobhena baḷisaṃ gilitvā byasanaṃ pāpuṇanto puthulomo'ti laddhanāmo maccho viya kāme apariccajitvā mā pacchā vihaññasi pacchā vighāṭaṃ āpajjasi.

examples.text: mā appakassa hetu, kāmasukhassa vipulaṃ jahī sukhaṃ, mā puthulomo'va baḷisaṃ, gilitvā pacchā vihaññasi.

24999.meaning1: known to householders; understood by laypeople
24999.commentary: (VINt) gihigatānī'ti gihipaṭisaṃyuttānī'ti vadanti. gihīsu gatāni, tehi ñātāni gihigatānī'ti evaṃ pan'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: suṇātu me, āvuso, saṅgho. sant'amhākaṃ sikkhāpadāni gihigatāni. gihino'pi jānanti, idaṃ vo samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī'ti.
